first_final_token_seconds.reason: not captured separately; TTFT is measured at the first content token

response_time_seconds.reason: streaming runs report TTFT and the decode window instead of total response time

decode_tokens_per_second.definition: stream decode over 5 runs, structured count task, thinking off

output_tokens_per_second_e2e.reason: per-run end-to-end output rates are tabulated in the receipt JSON instead

aggregate_tokens_per_second.reason: single-stream run; concurrent aggregate rates are in the receipt JSON

cached_tokens.reason: bench prompts are uniquely salted; server-side prefix-cache rates are in the receipt JSON
